department: Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
school: The Henry Samueli School of Engineering

requirements.name: Engineering Topics (complete each)
requirements.name_zh: 工程专业课（每组都要完成）

requirements.name: Technical Electives (min 3 courses, >=10 units)
requirements.note: Any EECS course not required for the major; at least one outside student's specialization; 4 units of EECS 199 = 1 elective
requirements.name_zh: 技术选修（至少 3 门、≥10 学分）
requirements.note_zh: 任意未被列为专业必修的 EECS 课；至少一门在本方向之外；EECS 199 的 4 学分 = 1 门选修

requirements.name: Specialization: Electronic Circuit Design (requires + select 4)
requirements.note: Requires: EECS 170D, EECS 170E; select 4 from pool
requirements.name_zh: 方向：电子电路设计（先修 + 选 4 门）
requirements.note_zh: 先修：EECS 170D、EECS 170E；再从池中选 4 门

requirements.name: Specialization: Semiconductors and Optoelectronics (requires + select 3)
requirements.note: Requires: EECS 174, EECS 188, PHYSICS 52A; select 3 from pool
requirements.name_zh: 方向：半导体与光电子（先修 + 选 3 门）

requirements.name: Specialization: RF, Antennas and Microwaves (requires + select 3)
requirements.note: Requires: EECS 144, EECS 180B, EECS 182; select 3 from pool
requirements.name_zh: 方向：射频、天线与微波（先修 + 选 3 门）

requirements.name: Specialization: Digital Signal Processing (requires + select 3)
requirements.note: Requires: EECS 22, EECS 152A, EECS 152B; select 3 from pool
requirements.name_zh: 方向：数字信号处理（先修 + 选 3 门）

requirements.name: Specialization: Communications (requires + select 4)
requirements.note: Requires: EECS 141A, EECS 141B; select 4 from pool
requirements.name_zh: 方向：通信（先修 + 选 4 门）
